events.title: 0.7 Alpha: Raids, Content Packs & More
events.summary: It's time to design some Raids - then share them! 0.7 is about the far end of your MMO. The instances you build can now become the thing a whole server organises around, the adventurers running them can change shape to suit the fight, and everything you author can finally leave your world and turn up in someone else's. events.title: 0.6 Alpha: Pets, Summons & Titles
events.summary: 0.6 is one of the largest MMOS updates so far. It gives adventurers new companions to fight beside, lets races enter the world through distinct starting areas, and adds a stack of new tools for shaping the world they play in. If you are continuing a 0.5.x world, MMOS will ask before upgrading it and keep a backup copy of the original save. Pets and summons Classes can now field up to three permanent companions at once. events.title: v0.5.1 Out Now: Races & Bug Fixes for Steam Demo Release
events.summary: New in 0.5.1Races Your MMO can now ship playable races. A new Races & Classes window (rebuilt to proper character-create proportions, with a live 3D preview that fills the stage) lets you author races with: a head cosmetic drawn from the mob head set, racial stat bonuses that fold into the same gear-bonus maths your items use, a faction, or Neutral for races anyone can roll, an allow-list of classes that race may play, enforced at character creation, release control, so a race only starts appear

events.title: v0.5 Out Now: Mounts, a Dungeon Tycoon Revamp and a Living Week
events.summary: The biggest MMOS update yet is live, and it is the one heading to the free demo. v0.5 makes your world feel alive: your adventurers ride and fly across it, your dungeons run like theme-park attractions you can read at a glance, and your servers finally have a real week. Mounts, ground and flying Stable vendors unlock in your cities and let adventurers buy ground mounts, with flying mounts as a further unlock. A full Mount editor lets you author bodies, flair colours, accessories and three sizes.

events.title: v0.4: Crafting, Bug Fixes, plus Mounts Coming Soon!
events.summary: Version 0.4 is here, hot on the heels of 0.3. I turned this one around quickly and have been working hard, so let me get straight into what has changed.Craft your own professionsThe headline feature.
